scenicChapters.title: Stelvio Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 22 km this is Stelvio Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Stelvio Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2621 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

gavia-pass.story: 58 km one way from Bormio - plan on about 1 h of riding. It goes by way of Santa Caterina Valfurva and Gavia Pass. The highest point is about 2,600 m. Gavia Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Manyara → Ngorongoro Crater rim
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 111 km. 2300 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Ngorongoro Crater rim → Olduvai Gorge
scenicChapters.narrative: 2300 m come off over 80 km at around 5.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

tanzania-ngorongoro-and-serengeti-route-.story: A one-way ride of 191 km, Mto wa Mbu to the finish - roughly 2 h 37 in the saddle. The highest point is about 2,300 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
